name: 炮灰女配逆袭成了太子妃
original_name: 炮灰女配逆袭成了太子妃
overview:
As a cannon-fodder side character, Su Niao was framed and poisoned by the female lead.

After being reborn, Su Niao vows to take revenge — but unexpectedly crosses paths with the Crown Prince Xie Chen Yan, beginning a fateful and extraordinary romance.
